previousRule: Mixed order review applies the curtain stock floor to every fabric in the combined requirements, including fabrics used only by cushions. A cushion fabric with enough governed stock for its cut plan can therefore block an otherwise ready mixed order.
newRule: Keep the fresh cushion set stock check for every cushion fabric. Apply the curtain stock floor to fabrics used by curtains, adding cushion consumption when both product types share that fabric. Continue to reject insufficient combined stock.
reason: A live mixed My Home review blocked a ready curtain and ready cushion because the cushion-only fabric was evaluated against the curtain 30 m stock floor. The release was rolled back. The focused regression preserves the shared-fabric stock safeguard while allowing independently sufficient cushion stock.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner authorised tracing and fixing the confirmed live release blocker, then completing the existing protected release workflow. The correction remains subject to a new exact-head Nylon1 approval comment on this PR before merge. No stock safeguard, payment boundary, or unrelated supplier policy is waived.
